name: meraki/schema
description: A library that provides a flexible, UI-agnostic solution for defining, validating, and serializing form schemas that can be used across multiple rendering environments and formats.

suggest.meraki/schema-json: Serialize a schema to JSON and back, so one definition can drive non-PHP consumers
suggest.meraki/schema-html: Render a schema as an HTML form, normalize request input, and produce validation messages

scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the suite with coverage (needs Xdebug or pcov).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run everything CI runs, in the same order.
scripts-descriptions.style: Fix formatting. Only applies changes that cannot alter behaviour.
scripts-descriptions.style:report: Report what the risky rules would change. Never writes.
scripts-descriptions.hooks:install: Point git at .githooks and teach git blame to skip the reformatting commits.
scripts-descriptions.test:examples: Run every example and fail if any exits non-zero.
scripts-descriptions.changelog: Regenerate CHANGELOG.md from the commit history.
scripts-descriptions.test:changelog: Fail if CHANGELOG.md is out of date.
scripts-descriptions.test:references: Fail if any {@see} in src/ points at something that does not exist.
